scope: Four approved quality review findings; local fixes and regressions

fixes.finding: P1 stale preview after recommendation conditions change
fixes.change: Synchronously clear result and map preview on effective condition changes; reject outdated responses and guard confirmation with the applied condition signature
fixes.regression: 1440px and 390px: change interests and keep IDs separately, verify old confirmation disappears and no save occurs, regenerate with latest conditions, then persist the kept place through the real API

fixes.finding: P2 explicitly closed places included in plans
fixes.change: Exclude openingHours=closed and tags.opening_hours=closed in spatial SQL and graph usability validation
fixes.regression: Both flags covered for catalog queries, rules, model drafts and kept places

fixes.finding: P2 NULL canonical links precede linked records
fixes.regression: Real DB publication of 120 unlinked and 1 linked facility; linked record is first and survives the result cap

fixes.finding: P2 retry exits before the requested strategy exists
fixes.change: Validate presence of the requested strategy before ending bounded retrieval
fixes.regression: An outdoor-only 10km result expands to indoor museums at 15km; unavailable indoor strategy stops after all three radii; pinned snapshots and one weather lookup preserved

limits: Tourism UI recommendation, source evidence and provider responses are fixtures; confirmation uses the real local API and PostgreSQL
No live HARP collection or current facility opening verification performed for this review
No production deployment or real-user recommendation-quality measurement
Existing uncommitted changes preserved; no commit or push
